content_sections.heading: NIPER Guwahati Section Officer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education & Research, Guwahati (NIPER-Guwahati)
Bachelor's degree in any discipline with 55% marks or grade B in the UGC seven-point scale or equivalent, plus at least 5 years' experience at Assistant level or equivalent
Below 40 Years (as on the closing date of application)

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Guwahati
content_sections.text: The notice describes NIPER-Guwahati as an autonomous institute of national importance and the first national pharma institute in NE India. It was set up by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Govt. of India, by an act of Parliament. The notice is signed by the Registrar (i/c).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may apply by emailing the documents in PDF format to [email protected] . The email must reach the institute latest by 30/11/2026 (up to 5 PM). Use this subject line: "Recruitment for the post of Section Officer". The notice asks for a CV as per the prescribed format. The notice text itself does not print the format or say where to download it.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university with 55% of the marks or grade B in the University Grant Commission seven-point scale or its equivalent, along with a good academic record, as laid down by University Grant Commission. At least 5 years of experience in Assistant Level or equivalent in handling administrative practices, human resource management, statutory functions and academic activities of Universities or Research and Development institutions or academic institutes. Administrative experience in a reputable Institution. Proven track record of operationalizing of academic University, Institution, Central/State Government. Experience in General Administration, Academic Administration, Establishment, Recruitment, handling of HR matters, and Documentation or Archives. Proficiency in the use of a variety of computer office applications, MS Word, MS Excel, Power Point or equivalent is must. The age limit is below 40 years, counted as on the closing date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. The post is on a contractual basis through an outsourcing agency. The period is initially 6 months, subject to extension based on performance. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: CV as per the prescribed format. Copies of all educational documents and experience certificates in chronological order. Both are to be sent in PDF format.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Section Officer post has two main stages, followed by the decision of the Selection Committee/Director. Applications will be scrutinized, and short-listing will be carried out based on the relevant work experience and knowledge of the relevant domains. Shortlisted candidates shall be invited either for a written test followed by an interview, or for an interview only (walk-in or online interview), by a Selection Committee. Which of the two applies is based on the number of candidates shortlisted. The notice prints no interview date or venue. The decision of the Selection Committee/Director, NIPER-Guwahati shall be final in all matters related to this selection and final recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Intimations will be sent only by E-mail or hosted on the website, as per the details mentioned in the CV.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIPER Guwahati Section Officer?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, up to 5 PM. The email with the documents must reach [email protected] by then.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for NIPER Guwahati Section Officer?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university with 55% marks or grade B in the UGC seven-point scale or equivalent, and at least 5 years of experience at Assistant level or equivalent in administration, HR, statutory functions and academic activities.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 40 years, as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIPER Guwahati Section Officer?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 40,000/- only.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for NIPER Guwahati Section Officer?
faq.answer: Email your CV in the prescribed format and copies of educational and experience documents, all in PDF, to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The subject line should be "Recruitment for the post of Section Officer".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized and shortlisted on relevant work experience and knowledge of the relevant domains. Shortlisted candidates face a written test followed by an interview, or an interview only (walk-in or online), depending on how many are shortlisted.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Section Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on a contractual basis through an outsourcing agency. It is initially for 6 months, subject to extension based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is computer knowledge required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice lists proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, Power Point or equivalent computer office applications as "must" under the desirable qualification.
